items.description: Report alternates between Core.updateDebt and FlashAccountant.updateDebt as the reentry target without clarifying the call path between Core and FlashAccountant; the core zeroing effect is still documented.
transferFrom is stated to possibly transfer 0 tokens or revert and that it 'doesn't matter', leaving the actual transfer outcome unspecified; only the reentry behavior is used in the core formula.

The report states no on-chain incident is independently verified and asserts the unconditional debt-modification capability without an independent source; the precondition is treated as an asserted report fact.
